name: Weekend liquidity recovery
hypothesis: Buy a confirmed recovery only when matched-size exit depth and independent trade counts return above their same-weekday baseline.
spec: Setup: A temporary thin period may end with restored participation. Entry: Buy a confirmed recovery only when matched-size exit depth and independent trade counts return above their same-weekday baseline. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if depth recedes or the recovery base breaks. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs chain activity, network cost or depth data beyond exchange price bars
